name: RadioButton
purpose: A single radio input — the individual option unit RadioGroup renders per choice, exposed on its own for cases that need one radio outside a full group (e.g. a single option embedded in a custom layout, or a hand-assembled set sharing `name`).
neverUseFor: A set of mutually exclusive options — use RadioGroup instead, which renders one of these per option with the correct fieldset/legend wrapper for free
A single independent on/off choice — use Checkbox or Switch instead
Anything needing search or many options — use Select instead

authored.name: checked
authored.description: Whether this radio is selected. Controlled via `checked`, uncontrolled via `defaultChecked` — same split as Switch.

anatomy.description: Wraps the input, visual control, and content — identical anatomy to one RadioGroup option, so it shares all of RadioGroup's CSS with no duplication.
Visual circle — reflects checked state via CSS.
Inner filled dot shown when checked.
Helper text. Sits exactly 4px below the label — same structure as Checkbox's own description.
Error text, shown instead of the description when `errorMessage` is set — identical structure to Checkbox's own error message.

props.name: name
props.description: Native radio group name, shared with any sibling RadioButtons it should be mutually exclusive with. Auto-generated (unique to this instance) if omitted — meaning it won't group with anything unless you set this explicitly.

props.name: value
props.description: Native radio value, read from the form on submit. Defaults to the native 'on' if omitted.

props.name: description
props.description: Helper text shown under the label. Not shown when errorMessage is also set.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Error text shown under the label when invalid is true — takes over from description.

height.note: Same fixed 16px control as RadioGroup's own option — this IS that option, standalone.
